name: splunk
description: Search logs, run SPL, inspect indexes, and investigate incidents in Splunk.

SPLUNK_MCP_URL.title: Splunk MCP server URL
SPLUNK_MCP_URL.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint copied from the Splunk MCP Server app. Example: the URL shown in the app after install. Do not use the deprecated *.api.scs.splunk.com On-Cloud endpoint for new deployments.

SPLUNK_MCP_TOKEN.title: Encrypted MCP token
SPLUNK_MCP_TOKEN.description: Encrypted authentication token generated in the Splunk MCP Server app. Encrypted tokens cannot be reused for direct Splunk REST API calls. Never commit this value.
